title: Software Engineer 2
description: Onsite role, primarily from an HPE office. Job family: designs, develops, troubleshoots and debugs software programs for software enhancements and new products, including operating systems, compilers, routers, networks, utilities, databases and Internet-related tools; determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design; translates customer requirements into functional specifications and implements them in languages such as Python and C++. Management level: intermediate subject-matter expertise on common technical problems; informed team member providing analysis and recommendations; works independently within an established framework with moderate supervision. What you'll do: understand and write correct functional specs for a requirement; design limited enhancements, updates and programming changes for portions and subsystems of systems software (operating systems, compilers, networking, utilities, databases, Internet-related tools); analyse design and determine coding, programming and integration activities; execute and write portions of test plans, protocols and documentation, identify and debug code issues and suggest improvements; achieve more than expected code coverage before commit; work as a project-team member with internal and outsourced development partners; communicate design status, project progress and issue resolution. Job level TCP_02; tags #india #networking; LinkedIn seniority 'Not Applicable'; industry IT Services and IT Consulting. Posted about 2026-11-11; over 200 applicants at fetch time.

required_skills: Very good understanding of networking fundamentals
Very good understanding of operating systems (Linux/Unix)
Designing software systems running on multiple platform types
Software systems testing methodology: test plans, debugging, testing scripts and tools
Strong written and verbal communication in English and the local language; communicating design proposals
preferred_skills: Systems software subsystems: operating systems, compilers, networking, utilities, databases
Collaboration with internal and outsourced development partners
requirements.education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent (required); typically 2-4 years experience

match.reasoning: Meets the degree requirement and the 'C++/Python' language requirement through Python (C++ is not supported; candidate confirmed no C++ experience on 2026-09-12). Supported strengths: production defect fixing, AKS regression testing and deployment validation, security-issue remediation, Python CLI/REST tooling, Java modernization, and documentation. Networking and Linux/Unix evidence is limited to coursework, listed skills, Kubernetes/Podman tooling, and corporate-network HTTP/TLS client work; no OS, compiler, router, or network-stack development is supported. Experience is below the typical 2-4 years: about 15 months full-time (Aug 2025-Nov 2026) plus a 7-month internship.
relevant_experience: Amadeus Software Development Engineer, Aug 2025-present: resolved a customer-reported stability defect in the currency exchange-rate sync service; supported AKS regression testing, deployment validation, reverts and redeployments; fixed Black Duck/Checkmarx/pen-test security issues; Java 17/Spring Boot 3 modernization.
Amadeus Software Development Intern, Jan-Jul 2025: Python/SQL/Splunk data extraction workflows.
Gear To Care Android Developer, Sep-Dec 2022: Android payments and authentication (another platform type).
relevant_projects: Black Duck Container Image Security Scanner (Amadeus internal): Python, Podman, REST APIs, CLI and packaged Windows executable.

GMS Knowledge Bot (Amadeus internal): HTTP client layer for the corporate network; documented architecture and troubleshooting.
